title: The Chicken Ghost
description: A vengeful spirit that appears after too many chickens are slain.
body:
The Chicken Ghost mod brings a terrifying new threat to Minecraft from the Trevor Henderson Universe. If you kill enough chickens, the creature will get aggressive. At first, only a warning appears, but as more chickens are killed, the Chicken Ghost begins to stalk the player. It’s bound to the night and vanishes at day. However, continued killing chickens drives it into a furious rage, turning it aggressive, fast, and destructive. It can even shatter wood and glass in pursuit of revenge. Once defeated, the haunting ends, and peace returns... at least until the next massacre.

<summary>Spoiler</summary>



► [OLD] What is my console spaming?

Most mobs use special spawning conditions, which means that these mobs can only appear under certain conditions. If the spawning conditions work, this spam is created in the console.

► [OLD] Why are Mobs not spawning?

Spawning Conditions determine which conditions must be met in order to spawn certain mobs. Some mobs only spawn above Y level 60. Some below. Most mobs can only spawn in the overworld than in other dimensions.

► Why are features missing in different versions?

It is recommended to play the newest versions of higher minecraft versions.

Not all features of MCreator available or the same in different versions.
For example: Version 1.19.2 doesn't have the feature of shield, better structure generation or custom villagers, but Version 1.20.1 does have them.

► How does the Chicken Ghost spawns?

Chicken Ghost spawns in Phase 2 and 3

In Phase 0, nothing will happen. You have to kill 8 chickens to increase the phase.

In Phase 1, the Chicken Ghost will make a sound an a warning text in the chat. If you kill 4 more chickens, the phase will increase to 2

In Phase 2, the Chicken Ghost will spawn during night and will always look to the nearest player. If a player comes closer than 16 blocks, it will vanish. If you kill 6 more chickens, the Phase will increase to 3

In Phase 3, the Chicken Ghost is aggressive if a player comes to close to the Cicken Ghost.

All Phases can be configurated by changing the number in the gamerule "chickenGhostPhase" to 0, 1, 2 or 3.

It can also be configurated by using the Phase Item which is accessable in creative mode or with cheats.

It can also be configurated by using the commands /chickenghost_phase_increase or /chickenghost_phase_decrease

► How can I disable the Chicken Ghost breaking blocks?

Chicken Ghost breaking blocks can be disabled if you set the gamerule "mobGriefing" to false.

► Does the mod work with the Long Horse mod?

Yes! Chicken Ghost is compatible with the Long Horse mod since his version 1.0 and the Long Horse Version 1.4. If you see Long Horse, it could increase the Chicken Ghost Phase, working as a warning.


</details>



![Chicken Ghost](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b91c0f5a94a454b4c41aa526be9316f8af1c2609.png)

The Chicken Ghost is a creature that spawns after the player kills enough chickens. Killing 8 chickens only result in a warning. But killing 4 more chickens will make the Chicken Ghost active. It remains distant, watching the player from the darkness and despawning during the day or if approached too closely. Killing 6 more chickens will result in the creature becoming aggressive, attacking players with high speed and strength, while breaking fragile blocks like glass and wood. It has slow falling like real chickens, is fast in water and every chicken within 50 blocks will look at the Chicken Ghost, even if the Chicken Ghost isn't visible. When killed, the Chicken Ghost resets the phase, ending its curse, unless you dare to anger it again. Eating Chicken Meat could also increase it's rage with 20%. Staying within 5 blocks to the Chicken Ghost while it's angry will give players weakness 1.
